component.name: ProbeItem
component.script:
sub init() m.label = CreateObject("roSGNode", "Label") m.label.translation = [10, 15] m.top.appendChild(m.label) end sub
sub onContent() m.label.text = m.top.itemContent.title end sub
sub onHasFocus() title = "?" if m.top.itemContent <> invalid then title = m.top.itemContent.title print "PROBE|item|" + title + ".itemHasFocus=" + m.top.itemHasFocus.toStr() end sub
